name: print-social-creativity-workshop-poster-red-duotone-tshirt-painting
title: 'Creativity Workshop' poster with a red duotone photo of hand-painting a T-shirt and a scrolling ticker header
whatItMeans: Bold and tactile; the duotone painting photo and scrolling ticker give a workshop poster real editorial energy.
whatItIs: A red-bordered poster with a black 'creativity' scrolling ticker band across the top, a wireframe globe icon, bold black 'Creativity Workshop' title, an orange tagline 'Find Your Type Of Creativity', social handles in a black bar, and a red-duotone photo of hands painting a zigzag pattern on a T-shirt.
techniques: Run a repeating word as a scrolling ticker band.
Duotone a process photo to match the brand's accent colour.
Pair a wireframe icon with bold flat type for contrast.

vocabulary.definition: A horizontal strip of repeating scrolling text.
An image showing an activity being performed, not just its result.
